newsitem.title: UK: UK insurance sector stocks buck weak market trend.
newsitem.headline: UK insurance sector stocks buck weak market trend.

text.p: UK insurance stocks shrugged off a weaker stock market on Thursday to push ahead on the back of positive comments from BZW, market sources said. By early afternoon, shares in Commercial Union had added 15p to 641p, General Accident 5p to 723-1/2p and Guardian Royal Exchange 7p to 265p.
In contrast, the FTSE 100 index of leading UK stocks was 23.2 points lower at 3,986.3.
BZW is understood to be preparing a research note on Commercial Union which argues that composite insurers have been overlooked recently and that the sector is due a re-rating.
In BZW's view, Commercial Union is the pick of the sector and, it says, it should be trading above 800p.
The sector also drew support from a NatWest upgrade of Guardian Royal Exchange to "add" from "hold".
